disclosure: Read from SEC filings of the ten largest S&P 500 companies in each GICS sector as they rank today, over the five years to the date shown; the same ten are read backwards, so earlier years are today's leaders' history, not that year's leaders. Most companies do not file their earnings-call transcript: the text is the earnings release and any remarks filed with it, and the MD&A, risk factors and business description of each 10-K and 10-Q. A sentence counts when a classifier fitted on hand-labelled sentences calls it a live constraint; the labels were written by a language model under a published codebook, so the classifier's scores measure agreement with those labels, not with the truth. A firm counts toward a need on two or more such sentences in the period. Supplier leaves are industries, not companies, and nothing here is a forecast of anyone's revenue or price.

foundry_packaging.label: Chip fabrication and packaging
foundry_packaging.covers: wafer fabrication, advanced packaging, substrates, chipmaking equipment

datacenter_capacity.label: Data-centre capacity
datacenter_capacity.covers: data-centre space and cloud capacity, built or leased

power_equipment.label: Power equipment
power_equipment.covers: transformers, turbines, switchgear, electrical and generation equipment

energy_fuel.label: Fuel and feedstock
energy_fuel.covers: natural gas, oil, fuel, pipeline takeaway, feedstock

raw_materials.label: Raw materials
raw_materials.covers: metals, minerals, chemicals, agricultural and other commodities, packaging materials

components_parts.label: Components and parts
components_parts.covers: manufactured parts and components: engines, castings, forgings, electronics

manufacturing_capacity.label: Manufacturing capacity
manufacturing_capacity.covers: production capacity, the filer's own or a contract manufacturer's

suppliers.label: The firm's own plant
suppliers.basis: most capacity limits are the filer's own production, which no one sells it

labor.label: Labour
labor.covers: workers: skilled trades, engineers, drivers, pilots, clinicians, staff generally

suppliers.label: The labour market
suppliers.basis: workers are hired, not bought from an industry

logistics.label: Freight and logistics
logistics.covers: freight, shipping, ports, rail, containers, trucking

construction.label: Construction
construction.covers: contractors, construction and engineering services, building materials

permits_approvals.label: Permits and approvals
permits_approvals.covers: permits, regulatory approvals, licences, export licences

suppliers.label: Regulators and governments
suppliers.basis: permits, approvals and licences are granted, not sold

finished_goods.label: Finished goods
finished_goods.covers: merchandise and finished products for resale, including medicines

real_estate.label: Land and real estate
real_estate.covers: land, sites, buildings, housing, property to buy or lease

unspecified.label: Input not named
unspecified.covers: a supply or capacity limit with the input not named

suppliers.label: Not named
suppliers.basis: the filing says supply is short without saying of what

statuses.LIVE: the filer's own output, growth or operations were or are limited by the availability of an outside input, or of its own capacity
statuses.SECURING: the filer is buying, contracting for or building more of an input because it needs more; no shortage is claimed
statuses.EASING: a constraint the filer had is described as improving or resolved

consistency.what: test-retest: a second pass by the same language model, blind to the first and to the firm
